author: BoldAndBrash
body:
I'm not exactly one to complain, but I have a feeling this has to be put out there. I've noticed that Avicus always seems to release things/fix things in huge updates. I believe if you guys tried fixing some things (i.e the extreme server lag that happens when people get near the monument) Avicus's efficiency would grow a ton. I mean, this Nise update was suppose to come out months ago and just an FYI, not everybody will wait forever. People are leaving for small things like server lag that can actually be fixed pretty fast.

Pleas don't lock this topic, it's just a randy giving some constructive feedback.

replies.author: PictureFrames
replies.body: There was never an official release date. Think of it this way, Finding Dory is the sequel to Finding Nemo, and sneak peaks were released last year in 2014. The movie itself isn't even coming out until 2016, so be patient. It's not only Avicus that's giving you a visual as to what to expect in the new update, movie producers are doing the same in their advertisement. The point is to keep you on the edge of your seat.
